_comment: Which palette-named material wears which surface texture (Assets/Art/Textures, made by tools/art/surface_textures.py), and how many tiles one repeat covers. The texture is a light grey pattern; the material's palette colour tints it, so a recolour keeps the pattern. Materials not listed are flat colour (docs/assets.md 4). tilesV (optional): the repeat's height, when it differs (plaster repeats once per storey, so its grime sits at the bottom).
